spec_title: Backup free-space guard + count-based retention — stop snapshot-driven disk-full

items.text: Free-space guard: snapshot skipped when available < max(2× last snapshot, `CO_BACKUP_MIN_FREE_BYTES` default 256 MiB); emits `backup.skipped_low_disk` on the EDA bus, WARN log, atividade entry — never errors the app
